title: Fine, electric mountain bikes don’t suck

paragraphs.text: It’s not cheating if you’re just having fun.
paragraphs.translation: 如果只是為了好玩，那就不是作弊。

paragraphs.text: If you buy something from a Verge link, Vox Media may earn a commission. See our ethics statement.
paragraphs.translation: 如果您透過 The Verge 的連結購買產品，Vox Media 可能會賺取佣金。請參閱我們的道德聲明。

paragraphs.text: Cheater, I’d grumble between huffs as yet another e-bike rider casually skittered past me on a steep ascent. It’s this purist attitude that, for years, has left me blind to one simple fact: electric mountain bikes are fun!
paragraphs.translation: 「作弊者，」當另一位電動自行車騎士在陡峭的坡道上輕鬆地從我身邊滑過時，我會在喘息間咕噥著。正是這種純粹主義者的態度，多年來讓我忽視了一個簡單的事實：電動登山車非常有趣！

paragraphs.text: My attitude adjustment came a few weeks ago, the very first time I rode an Amflow PX Carbon Pro fitted with the incredibly compact, lightweight, and powerful M2S motor from Avinox, a new DJI offshoot that has incumbents like Bosch and Specialized on edge. The motor doesn’t make me a speed demon, but it does let me suck better by compensating whenever my poor technique kills the momentum.
paragraphs.translation: 我的態度轉變發生在幾週前，那是我第一次騎乘配備 Avinox 強大 M2S 馬達的 Amflow PX Carbon Pro，Avinox 是大疆 (DJI) 的新分支機構，讓 Bosch 和 Specialized 等老牌廠商倍感壓力。這具馬達並未讓我變成速度狂，但當我蹩腳的技術損耗動量時，它能透過補償讓我「遜得比較有水準」。

paragraphs.text: Mountain biking has a long history of gatekeeping new technology. Purists have complained about the introduction of full-suspension frames, disc brakes, dropper posts, and 29-inch wheels, claiming they’ve made the sport “too easy.” Today, that technology is widely accepted and comes standard on many mountain bikes, including the Amflow I’ve been testing. Powerful, torquey motors are just the next evolution.
paragraphs.translation: 登山車運動在排斥新技術方面有著悠久的歷史。純粹主義者曾抱怨引入全避震車架、碟煞、升降座管和 29 吋輪圈，聲稱這些讓這項運動變得「太簡單」。如今，這些技術已廣泛被接受，並成為許多登山車的標配，包括我一直在測試的 Amflow。強大且高扭力的馬達只是下一個演進。

paragraphs.text: Without a doubt, that motor does make things easier. It’s on long, steep, technical ascents where I appreciate the relief most, turning climbs into engaging, flowy challenges rather than a cardio tax that cuts my day short. But I decide how hard I want to work. Some days I need a turbo assist, and others I’m fine with eco when I really want to push my heart rate into the red zone.
paragraphs.translation: 毫無疑問，那具馬達確實讓事情變得更輕鬆。在漫長、陡峭且具技術性的爬坡中，我最能體會到那種解脫，它將爬坡轉化為迷人且流暢的挑戰，而不是縮短我一天行程的心肺負擔。但我決定自己想出多少力。有時候我需要渦輪輔助，有時當我想將心率推向極限時，使用節能模式也沒問題。

paragraphs.text: I started mountain biking during covid like many of my friends, letting YouTube teach us correct body posture and technique to use in turns and jumps. Let’s just say I haven’t advanced much beyond novice in that time, and suffered a nasty crash that shoved my shoulder out the socket “in an unusual direction,” according to my doctor. I haven’t felt as confident on a mountain bike since. Adding a motor, however, has made me feel safer with a greater sense of control.
paragraphs.translation: 我和許多朋友一樣在疫情期間開始騎登山車，讓 YouTube 教導我們在轉彎和跳躍時正確的身體姿勢與技巧。只能說這段時間我的技術並未超越新手多少，還遭遇了一次嚴重的摔車，據醫生說，我的肩膀朝「不尋常的方向」脫臼了。從那以後，我在登山車上就沒那麼自信了。然而，加入馬達後，讓我感到更安全且更有控制感。

paragraphs.text: There’s a gross misconception that electric mountain bikes (eMTBs) make you faster. Maybe in the US, but I ride in Europe where eMTBs don’t have throttles and the pedal-assist tops out at a slow 25km/h (15.5mph) — many trail riders can easily exceed 30km/h on straightaways, leaving me struggling to keep up on a heavier e-bike. European e-bikes also have a maximum continuous output rating of just 250W, making them slower and less powerful than Class 1 e-bikes sold in the US, let alone those Class 3 monsters that are just motorcycles in disguise.
paragraphs.translation: 有個嚴重的誤解是電動登山車 (eMTB) 會讓你變快。在美國或許是，但在歐洲，eMTB 沒有油門，且踏板輔助的上限僅為慢速的時速 25 公里（15.5 英里）——許多林道騎士在平直路段可以輕鬆超過時速 30 公里，讓我騎著較重的電動車苦苦追趕。歐洲的電動自行車最大持續輸出功率也僅為 250W，比美國銷售的 Class 1 電動車更慢、馬力更小，更不用說那些偽裝成機車的 Class 3 怪獸了。

paragraphs.text: I don’t want my eMTB to ride the trail for me. Instead, I want the pedal-assisted motor to act as a force multiplier, seamlessly integrating with my own pedaling to provide as much or as little assistance as I desire. That’s what I get with the Amflow PX Carbon Pro and eMTBs that cost much less.
paragraphs.translation: 我不希望我的 eMTB 替我騎完整條林道。相反地，我希望踏板輔助馬達扮演「力量倍增器」的角色，與我自己的踩踏無縫結合，根據我的需求提供或多或少的協助。這就是我在 Amflow PX Carbon Pro 和價格低得多的 eMTB 上所得到的體驗。

paragraphs.text: The motor lets me be overly cautious with my braking as I approach a turn, take it with confidence, and then accelerate quickly and with control out the other side. And when my momentum stalls in a technical section because of my shit technique, a bolt of torque is there to get me out of trouble, and again when a blind hairpin opens up to an unexpectedly steep incline.
paragraphs.translation: 馬達讓我在接近彎道時能過度謹慎地煞車，有信心地過彎，然後以受控的方式快速從另一側加速。當我的動量因為蹩腳的技術在技術路段停滯時，一股扭力會幫助我脫困，當盲彎後出現意想不到的陡坡時也是如此。

paragraphs.text: The extra power delivered intuitively and predictably by the Avinox M2S motor has kept me from losing balance, or being forced to dismount in difficult terrain. It’s also been a great equalizer when heading out with more experienced riders who’d otherwise “drop” me at some point in the first 10 minutes.
paragraphs.translation: Avinox M2S 馬達直覺且可預測地傳遞額外動力，讓我避免失去平衡，或被迫在困難地形下車。當我和更有經驗的騎士一起出門時，它也是一個絕佳的「平等器」，否則他們會在前 10 分鐘的某個時刻就把我「甩掉」。

paragraphs.text: As a result, I find myself smiling a lot more, ready to spend more time on the trails, doing more laps, and more repetitions. I’m just having so much more fun these days even though my old, middle-aged self is riding the same old trails.
paragraphs.translation: 因此，我發現自己笑容變多了，準備好在林道上待更久，進行更多圈數和更多重複練習。即使我這個中年人騎的是同樣的老路線，最近還是覺得有趣得多。

paragraphs.text: I’m also careful with my newfound superpower, and frankly, a little embarrassed by it. Strong riders aren’t used to being passed with pace on steep uphill sections by someone twice their age. I therefore stay humble and announce my presence early if I really need to pass. I also don’t claim any King of the Mountain titles on Strava like some assholes.
paragraphs.translation: 我對自己的新超能力也很謹慎，坦白說，還有一點尷尬。強壯的騎士不習慣在陡峭的上坡路段被年紀比他們大一倍的人快速超越。因此，我保持謙遜，如果真的需要超車，我會提早告知。我也不會像某些混蛋一樣在 Strava 上爭奪「山路之王」(KOM) 的頭銜。

paragraphs.text: It’s slightly unfair that my epiphany came on a $10,000 Amflow PX Carbon Pro. It features class-leading specs that certainly aided my enjoyment. That Avinox M2S motor is capable of delivering up to 150Nm of hill-flattening torque, and a temporary boost of 1,500W to overcome long, steep sections. (Watch Will Greenfield’s e-bike motor comparison to fully appreciate what Avinox has done.) The carbon fiber frame also helps bring the total weight down to just 20.6kg (45 pounds), below the average of about 22 to 27kg (50 to 60 pounds).
paragraphs.translation: 稍微不公平的是，我的頓悟發生在價值一萬美元的 Amflow PX Carbon Pro 上。它擁有領先同級的規格，確實增加了我的樂趣。那具 Avinox M2S 馬達能提供高達 150Nm 的「剷平山坡」扭力，以及 1,500W 的臨時增壓來克服漫長的陡坡。（觀看 Will Greenfield 的電動車馬達對比，就能充分理解 Avinox 的成就。）碳纖維車架也有助於將總重量降低至僅 20.6 公斤（45 磅），低於約 22 到 27 公斤（50 到 60 磅）的平均值。

paragraphs.text: Avinox now boasts over 60 bike brand partners around the world. That means it pays to shop around. The cheapest M2S-equipped eMTB I’ve found is the roughly $4,000 CRUSSIS e-Hard 11.11 hardtail. Otherwise, you can find a variety of budget eMTBs from companies like Ride1Up and Aventon with less-capable motors that still offer lots of fun.
paragraphs.translation: Avinox 現在在全球擁有超過 60 個自行車品牌合作夥伴。這意味著貨比三家是值得的。我發現最便宜的配備 M2S 的 eMTB 是大約 4,000 美元的 CRUSSIS e-Hard 11.11 硬尾車。此外，你也可以從 Ride1Up 和 Aventon 等公司找到各種平價的 eMTB，雖然馬達性能稍弱，但依然充滿樂趣。

paragraphs.text: Ultimately, you don’t need a five-figure carbon rig to experience the shift. Whether you’re on a flagship Amflow or a budget workhorse, the result will be similar: less suffering, more laps, and a giant, goofy grin. The addition of a motor won’t suddenly make you a better mountain biker. But it might make you want to become one.
paragraphs.translation: 最終，你不需要五位數美金的碳纖維裝備來體驗這種轉變。無論你騎的是旗艦款 Amflow 還是平價的馱馬，結果都大同小異：痛苦減少、圈數增加，以及一個巨大的、傻傻的笑容。加入馬達不會突然讓你變成更好的登山車手。但它可能會讓你想要成為一個。

quiz.sentence: He was so focused on winning that he was ____ the feelings of his teammates.
quiz.sentence_zh: 他一心只想贏，以至於忽視了隊友的感受。

quiz.sentence: The mountain climbers started their final ____ to the summit at dawn.
quiz.sentence_zh: 登山者在黎明時分開始了向頂峰的最後衝刺（向上攀升）。

quiz.sentence: The company decided to ____ its employees for the extra hours they worked during the holiday.
quiz.sentence_zh: 公司決定對員工在假期期間額外工作的小時數給予補償。

quiz.sentence: After winning three games in a row, the team has a lot of ____ heading into the finals.
quiz.sentence_zh: 在連續贏得三場比賽後，球隊進入決賽時擁有強大的勢頭（動量）。

quiz.sentence: Investors are being very ____ about putting money into the volatile stock market right now.
quiz.sentence_zh: 投資者目前對於將資金投入波動劇烈的股市表現得非常謹慎。

quiz.sentence: She had a sudden ____ while walking in the park and finally realized what she wanted to do with her life.
quiz.sentence_zh: 在公園散步時，她突然有了一個頓悟，終於意識到她一生想要做什麼。

quiz.sentence: You should ____ before buying a new laptop to make sure you get the best price.
quiz.sentence_zh: 買新筆電之前你應該貨比三家，以確保獲得最優惠的價格。

quiz.sentence: This heavy-duty truck engine produces enough ____ to tow a large boat up a steep hill.
quiz.sentence_zh: 這台重型卡車引擎能產生足夠的扭力，將一艘大船拖上陡坡。

quiz.sentence: Even though he is a ____ at coding, he managed to build a simple website in just two days.
quiz.sentence_zh: 儘管他在寫程式方面是個新手，他還是設法在短短兩天內建立了一個簡單的網站。

quiz.sentence: The news of the upcoming layoffs has everyone in the office feeling ____.
quiz.sentence_zh: 即將裁員的消息讓辦公室裡的每個人都感到緊張不安。
